prior_summary: Predict absolute Cartesian TCP poses in the source-container frame frozen at each chunk start, while conditioning on source-to-bowl geometry and Panda state.
applicable_conditions: Prefer for an upright, observable source displaced from the narrow demonstrated table range, especially before handle acquisition. Source and destination must remain reachable and use the demonstrated handle geometry.
termination_guidance: Terminate or hand off only after closed fingers, observable source/TCP co-motion, table clearance, and high staging above the bowl with only a small tilt; nominally hand off after staging, while [180,360) supports earlier switching after secure lift.
limitations: Source anchoring directly protects acquisition against source translation but does not remove reachability, collision, grasp-contact, or fixed destination dependencies. No failed-grasp or slip recovery is demonstrated; large rotations and mid-chunk slips are unsupported.
